location.name: Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory Semmel Center

arrival.title: Parking
arrival.description: There will be parking signs to help guide you to the lower parking lot behind the Semmel Center where ample parking will be available.

faqs.question: What do I need to know when visiting APL?
faqs.answer: Please view our [Visiting APL](https://www.jhuapl.edu/about/visiting-apl) page for full details.

faqs.question: Can I take photos at the event?
faqs.answer: Please view our [controlled items policy](https://www.jhuapl.edu/about/visiting-apl/controlled-items-policy). Taking photographs inside of the Laboratory is prohibited without written permission from the APL Security Office.
